test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 14th_September_2025_Shift_1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about Hola Mohalla festival of Punjab is **correct**?

options.text: It is celebrated mainly by women through crafts and songs in Patiala.
It showcases martial arts, langars, and Nihang mock battles at Anandpur Sahib.
It is a harvest festival observed in Punjab just before Diwali.
Hola Mohalla is celebrated on the same day as Holi.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It showcases martial arts, langars, and Nihang mock battles at Anandpur Sahib.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hola Mohalla** is a Sikh festival that was first introduced by Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru, in 1701.
 
• The festival is celebrated a day after Holi and is marked by demonstrations of **martial arts, mock battles by Nihang warriors, and traditional Sikh customs**.
 
• The main celebrations are held at **Anandpur Sahib**, a significant Sikh pilgrimage site in Punjab.
 
• It is known for its **community kitchens (langars)**, where free meals are served to all visitors as part of Sikh tradition.
 
• The festival also includes **religious processions, poetry recitations, and devotional music**, making it a vibrant cultural and spiritual event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It seems to be a misrepresentation of certain other cultural festivals in Punjab where women actively participate in folk activities like *Giddha* and *Phulkari*.
 
• In Punjab, **Baisakhi** is the prominent harvest festival celebrated in April to mark the wheat harvesting season.
 
• Hola Mohalla is celebrated **a day after Holi** and is distinct in its focus on martial traditions and Sikh spiritual values.
